features.name: throughput
features.definition: DASH safe average throughput in Mbps /10

features.name: rtt
features.definition: valid typed RTT ms /200; zero when invalid

features.name: rtt_valid
features.definition: current probe valid, finite and last success younger than3s

features.name: rtt_age
features.definition: seconds since last successful probe /3; missing maps to1

features.name: rtt_change
features.definition: latest minus oldest valid RTT in last8 polled health rows /200; zero if fewer than2

training_state: Up to30 unique matched completed-request rows, each with original9-vector, applied action and download-surrogate reward; fixed coordinates and rolling refit
runtime: Synchronous Pyodide call to MABWiser2.7.0 LinTS; alpha1 and seed123456

reward.qualification: Completed-download utility and buffer-budget starvation surrogate, not actual played QoE. Seek/error/unmatched outcomes censored, with acceptance coverage reported.

startup: One conservative choice per slot, and until first mature feedback row; startup factor0.45 when buffer<1s else0.70
guard: For guard variant, clip proposal to highest nominal rate below safe-throughput times0.55 if buffer<1s, delay>target+2s or probe invalid, else0.85. Lowest arm remains possible below its rate.
guard_only_control: Standalone ceiling heuristic replaces both learned and conservative forced choices; not a pure removal of learning
missing_data: Typed RTT validity/age explicit; no future scenario labels or direct MongoDB reads
reset: Fresh controller/online history per browser trial; shared producer has ref-counted cleanup
clock: hostClock=1 only for verified single-host emulation; external clock synchronization remains default otherwise
example: models/final/cmab/example-state.json generated after validation selection, including online state needed for replay
